Veteran Tamil Filmmaker K. Bhagyaraj Dies at 73

K. Bhagyaraj, a veteran filmmaker and writer in the Tamil film industry, has passed away at the age of 73 due to a heart attack. He was known for his contributions to screenplay development in Tamil cinema. His death has been met with tributes from fellow filmmakers and politicians, including Chief Minister Vijay and actor Rajinikanth.
